run_pulsar_scene_optimization: run the pulsar scene optimization example that optimizes random spheres to match a reference image using gradient descent
create_scenemodel_with_pulsar_renderer: create a SceneModel PyTorch module with learnable sphere positions, colors, and radii rendered via the pulsar Renderer
optimize_scene_with_sgd: optimize a pulsar scene model using SGD with per-parameter learning rates for colors, radii, and positions
render_pulsar_scene_forward: render a pulsar scene by calling the SceneModel forward method with sphere parameters and camera settings
review_scenemodel_parameters: review the SceneModel class parameters including vert_pos, vert_col, vert_rad, and cam_params for pulsar rendering
